All admin pages use consistent AdminSidebar component for navigation
Stats are fetched from /api/users endpoint and calculated client-side
Change role modal uses PUT /api/users/{id} to update user role
Student and Teacher modals have comprehensive form validation
Academic data (levels, grades, sections, shifts) fetched from /api/academic/* endpoints
data-testid attributes present on key elements for testing

The portal includes: Dashboard with stats and quick actions, Users management with role change functionality, Students management with CRUD and academic info, Teachers management with course assignments.
